## P1.7 — bounded validation repairs and authorization

The host-key schema deliberately changes default reads from integer to string. Existing core helper expectations for actor/tenant in all three ID strategies and the persisted share.granted_by assertion were updated to that contract. The snapshot gate now reflects HostKeyColumns and VaulterSchema. No assertion was loosened.

Core's TestCase previously selected SQLite for DB_CONNECTION=mysql. Its test connection resolver now selects real MySQL/MariaDB and refuses non-*_test persistent databases. A fixture-only MySQL TestCase omits the unrelated tree migrations, allowing an additional real-MySQL suite to prove all 27 host columns, values, nullability, indexes, all four types, idempotency and down(). The declared full-install MySQL command still runs and its error is retained rather than hidden.

The owner's explicit reply in this invocation was: «Разрешаю исправить три assertions». The permission question identified precisely two drive assertions (created_by 42 and tenant_id 99887766) and one documents assertion (resolved_by 7) as stale integer expectations, and cited AGENTS.md and the P1.7 Files boundary. Only those three assertions change in sibling packages; their full gates are rerun. No sibling product code changes.

The new V23 fresh-panel setup runs after automatic migrations, so the upgrade cannot hide a wrong fresh-schema subject_id type. Its mandated negative control fails on PostgreSQL inserting the UUID into char(26), and the restored test passes.

The MySQL 8 installation defect is pre-existing and assigned to PLAN2.P8.1 by the P1.7 contract. mysql-baseline-classification.json and mysql-known-deviation.md retain its proof and exact limits. No acceptance threshold or test skip was changed to accept the defect.
